scientific_integrity.claim: The commuting-map constant-power probability is exactly \(1/N\); the number of constant-power binary magma operations on \(n\geq2\) elements is \(n^{n^2-2}\).
scientific_integrity.domain: finite labeled involutions with at least one fixed point and the finite binary magma monoid
scientific_integrity.limits: No extension is claimed to fixed-point-free involutions, arbitrary permutation groups, or uniform algebra-isomorphism classes. Absolute historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain unperformed.
scientific_integrity.verification: Symbolic Prüfer-weighted forest proof and finite exhaustive tests for \(n\leq3\) plus nine small involution types.

title: Symmetry-neutral synchronization for involution-equivariant maps and magma monoids
